2026 – Present · Design & development

VARYNT

AI creator platform. A multi-page Framer website across several product verticals.

FramerCustom TSX componentsCMSLight + dark
  • Structured and designed pages across multiple product verticals. Every section is a custom TSX component that non-developers edit through Framer property controls.
  • Designed pricing cards with a monthly / annual toggle, voice and image studio interfaces, and an earnings dashboard, with themes that follow the site toggle.
  • Scroll-triggered animation and layouts that hold down to 320px. Client QA reports and change requests turned into shipped revisions.

2026 – Present · Product UI design & development

CallTrek

SIM-based call analytics platform for sales teams: a web app for company admins and an Android app for the people on the phones.

FigmaAngularNode.jsDesktop · Tablet · Mobile · Android
  • Designing the full product interface: dashboard, team and roles, call logs, leads, reports, integrations and sign-in flows, in light and dark themes.
  • Replaced the generic web-app layout with a distinctive navigation system: a floating pill navbar with segmented tabs, a vertical icon dock and soft glass-style cards.
  • The Android app puts tracking status, untagged calls and follow-ups on one home screen, and keeps personal calls on the phone.
  • Developing the platform in Angular and Node.js alongside the design work.

How I work

Call to launch

Direct with clients and developers, delivered in rounds.

Start with a call
  1. 01

    Scope

    Agree the offer, the pages and the deadline with the client before anything is drawn.

  2. 02

    Design

    Layouts and visual assets in Figma and Canva, light and dark where the product needs both.

  3. 03

    Build

    Framer, GoHighLevel, ClickFunnels or Angular, with CRM pipelines and follow-up automations wired in.

  4. 04

    Test

    Cross-browser and device checks from 320px up, with issues tracked until they’re closed.

  5. 05

    Revise & ship

    QA reports and change requests become revisions, then the page goes live.
